units.source_text: 那正是杜子春日夜思念的母亲说的话，

en.t: Those were the very words spoken by the mother Du Zichun had longed for day and night.
Du Zichun suddenly opened his eyes.

units.source_text: 看见一匹瘦马哀哀的伏在地上，满含热泪，正盯着自己看。

en.t: He saw a thin horse lying pitifully on the ground, its eyes full of hot tears, staring straight at him.

units.source_text: 目前在这样的痛苦里挣扎，却还惦记着体谅儿子的苦衷，

en.t: Even while struggling in such agony, the horse before him was still thinking of his suffering as a son.

units.source_text: 甚至对贵卒的殴打也没有怨恨。

en.t: It held no resentment even toward the guards who had beaten it.

units.source_text: 但世间的人，你是大财主的时候，他们便来阿谀奉承，

en.t: But people in the world flatter and fawn on you when you are rich.

units.source_text: 当你贫穷潦倒的的时候，便不假辞色。

en.t: When you are poor and ruined, they will not spare you a kind word or look.

units.source_text: 这么一想比，母亲的品质是多么的可贵啊，

en.t: Thinking of the contrast, how precious his mother's character was.

units.source_text: 母亲的决心是多么的多么坚决！

en.t: How firm, how utterly firm, his mother's resolve was.

units.source_text: 杜子春忘了老人家的吩咐，

en.t: Du Zichun forgot the old man's instructions.

units.source_text: 连滚带爬的挪到目前旁边，

en.t: He rolled and crawled his way over beside the horse before him.

units.source_text: 双手紧紧抱着垂死挣扎的老马的脖子，

en.t: He clasped the neck of the dying, struggling old horse tightly with both hands.
With hot tears wetting his cheeks, he cried out, Mother.
